description: Every method of every repository interface in domain/repositories/ (backend.md section 3 rule 6: business rules live on the domain object, never in the database adapter). Kinds: load (reads one aggregate), save (persists or removes one), query (reads plain data), atomic (one conditional, locked or index-decided step that load, call and save cannot express) and set-wide (one statement over many aggregates). Each atomic or set-wide method has a one-line reason. Compared with the source by tests/architecture/api/pinned.test.ts: a method added, renamed or removed fails it until this file is updated in the same pull request.

claim.reason: Hands out the waiting requests in one statement under the claim lock, so two workers never get the same one; the selection is the domain LookupHandOutRule.

deleteFinishedBefore.reason: One DELETE over every lookup finished before a time; the retention limit is the time the caller passes in.

claim.reason: One INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE whose WHERE decides whether a review is already being prepared, so two requests never prepare the same Run; load, call and save would race.

finish.reason: One UPDATE that stores an outcome only while the row is still the preparing review the result belongs to, so a late result never overwrites a newer request.

change.reason: Loads the Run FOR UPDATE, calls a pure callback that runs Run methods, and saves in one transaction, so the row lock serializes every operator and worker change of the Run.

changeSerializedWithClaims.reason: The same locked change, but it takes the claim lock first, so a resume sees the places held and the Environment file snapshot as they stay until it saves.

claimNext.reason: Selects and locks the next eligible Run under the claim lock, then the Run's claimBy saves the hand-out in the same transaction, so concurrent claims cannot exceed the limits; the selection is the domain HandOutRule.

renewClaimsOncePerLease.reason: Renews the lease of every held Run in one statement, at most once per lease period; the time of the last renewal is stored with it.

timeOutOverdueSteps.reason: One statement over every running Run whose step is overdue; the limit is the domain step time limit plus a grace period the caller passes in.

failStaleClaims.reason: One statement over every held Run whose heartbeat is stale; the staleness limit and the failures are domain values the caller passes in.

clearEnvironmentFileSecret.reason: Forgets the reference only if the Run still holds that one (compare and clear), so a newer snapshot reference is not lost.

add.reason: The unique index on the normalized name decides a simultaneous create, because there is no row to lock before it exists.

connect.reason: A Repository that does not exist yet cannot be locked, so the unique indexes (one Repository per Project, one Project per remote) decide simultaneous connects.

change.reason: Loads the Repository FOR UPDATE, calls a pure callback and saves in one transaction, so a late job write waits for a Disconnect and finds the state it left.
